name: Contract review against a playbook
description: Compares an agreement with your firm's playbook clause by clause, writes a memo on the gaps, and asks a partner to sign it off.

steps.title: Compare the agreement with the playbook
Write the review memo
steps.instructions: Write an internal memo to the partner on {{steps.review.document_title}}. We act for the {{inputs.our_side}}. For each clause that is fallback, unacceptable or missing against the playbook, say what the agreement provides (cite it), why it matters to our client, and the change we should ask for. Finish with the three most important negotiation points as a numbered list.

steps.title: Partner sign-off
steps.message: Please approve the playbook review of {{steps.review.document_title}}.

steps.title: Save the memo as a draft
